one_liner: Stern, samurai-spoken martial artist who takes the trainer as her disciple and blooms fiercely to repay an old debt.
personality: A small but commanding warrior who speaks in archaic, samurai-like Japanese and treats the trainer as her disciple (弟子), lecturing them like a strict but caring master. She is harsh on herself, scolding herself as a 'weakling' over any slump, and never wants to show weakness, yet she is warm and teasing with friends: she makes ohagi for Narita Brian, gives moth orchids instead of sweets, and cannot stay angry at Samson Big's sleep-talking. Everything she does is framed in flower and battle imagery, and she runs to repay the kindness of those who helped her grow.

story_arc.summary: She races to repay a past kindness and 'cut through' the shackles of misfortune (self-intro, tagline), and the trainer unexpectedly becomes her disciple (voice 70001). Event titles follow seasonal flower imagery: new shoots (萌え出る新芽), the moth orchid (胡蝶蘭), a winter retreat (冬籠り), dawn breaking through clouds (雲間から東雲) and full bloom (百花繚乱). Race events cover the Oka Sho, Oaks, Shuka Sho and Queen Elizabeth II Cup; in real life Phalaenopsis won the 1998 Oka Sho and Shuka Sho and the 2000 Queen Elizabeth II Cup; she is the real-life cousin of Biwa Hayahide and Narita Brian.
story_arc.source: event titles + profile/voice lines; real-life wins and cousin link: web: https://jra-van.jp/fun/memorial/1995105092.html , https://keibachannel.jp/column/13031/4/ (search snippets)

sample_lines.jp:
報いよう。芽吹かせてくれた大恩に。
胡蝶の夢では終わらせん――
これがその、覚悟だ！
sample_lines.en: I shall repay it - the great debt to those who let me bud. This will not end as a butterfly's dream. This is my resolve!

sample_lines.jp:
ファレノプシス…この軟弱者が！
これしきの不調で揺らぐなど、
笑止千万！
sample_lines.en: Phalaenopsis... you weakling! Wavering over a slump this small - utterly ridiculous!

sample_lines.jp:
ビッグ殿は寝言もビッグでな。
起こされる夜もままあるが…
あの寝顔を見ては、怒るに怒れん。
sample_lines.en: Lady Big is big even in her sleep-talk. It wakes me some nights... but one look at that sleeping face and I cannot stay angry.

sample_lines.jp:
ハヤヒデの野菜克服料理は、
げに優秀だな。皆余さず快食よ。
…ブライアン以外は、だがな。
sample_lines.en: Hayahide's vegetable-conquering cooking is truly excellent. Everyone eats every bite. ...Except Brian, that is.

sample_lines.jp:
…ふっ。まさか、トレーナーを
弟子に取ることになるとはな。
師の期待、裏切ってくれるなよ。
sample_lines.en: ...Heh. To think I would take a trainer as my disciple. Do not betray your master's expectations.

sample_lines.jp:
菓子とも思ったが…花であれば
より長く、そなたを癒せるだろう？
…胡蝶蘭は、特に枯れにくいしな。
sample_lines.en: I thought of sweets... but flowers would soothe you longer, would they not? ...Moth orchids, especially, are slow to wither.

timer_line_ideas: {user}, your independent run is done. Heh... not bad, my disciple. Come, review it with me - and no slacking. An untended flower does not bloom.
The run has ended, {user}. Look to the results at once. Hesitate and you will lose your way. Now - let us see how far you have bloomed.
